snippet.title: Of Dice and Minions - Official Trailer | Dice-Rolling Auto Battler Roguelite
snippet.description:
Roll five dice. Poker hands summon your army. Then watch them battle.

Of Dice and Minions is a dice-rolling auto battler roguelite. Hold and reroll your dice to land pairs, full houses and five of a kinds, each one summoning a bigger army of minions. Then sit back as they clash with the dungeon's hordes, and descend 100 floors of bosses, jackpots, mimic heists and treasure.

Launching November 16, 2026 on Steam (Windows, Mac, Linux, Steam Deck).
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4984370/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=trailer&utm_content=official

Features
- Poker-hand dice rolls that summon minion armies
- 100 floors across ten dungeon zones, with a boss every tenth floor who rolls its own dice
- Jackpot reels, mimic heists, treasure chests and relics
- Recruit and upgrade your minions between runs
- Made by one solo developer

#OfDiceAndMinions #AutoBattler #Roguelite #IndieGame #PixelArt
